name: 77023 · Houston, TX
findings: ZIP 77023 (Houston) has 58 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77023 (Houston) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 77023 (Houston) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
